async function craftOneIronAxeTask(bot) {
    // The function checks if an iron axe is already in the inventory; if not, it verifies if at least two sticks are present. It then determines how many iron ingots are needed and attempts to mine iron ore if insufficient ingots are available. If ore is found, it smelts the raw iron into ingots using a nearby furnace and coal. Finally, it locates a crafting table and crafts one iron axe if enough ingots have been obtained.
}
